name: Reception from Tyrande
summary: Sentinel Thenysil sends you from Astranaar to Darnassus for an audience with Tyrande Whisperwind. After you help the Sentinels hold their ground against the Venture Company in Stonetalon, Tyrande receives you at the Temple of the Moon.

sections.title: A Foothold in Stonetalon
sections.body: The Venture Company puts pressure on night elf outposts across the Stonetalon Mountains. Sentinel Thenysil coordinates the defense from Astranaar, but the remote bases are hard to sustain. Supply lines and intelligence help the Sentinels keep an Alliance presence in Kalimdor's interior, and your aid strengthens their position.

sections.title: Audience with the High Priestess
sections.body: After your help bolsters the Sentinels in Stonetalon, Sentinel Thenysil sends you back to Teldrassil. Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess, grants you an audience at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes your deeds across Kalimdor and welcomes you as an ally fighting alongside the kaldorei.

aliases: where do i get reception from tyrande
faq.answer: Sentinel Thenysil gives you this work in Astranaar, Ashenvale, after you complete 'Update for Sentinel Thenysil'.

faq.q: Where can I find Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind is in the Temple of the Moon, in Darnassus's central district on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Tyrande want to see me?
faq.answer: Your efforts in Stonetalon help preserve the Kaldorei foothold in contested mountain territory. Sentinel Thenysil believes your service merits appreciation from the night elves' spiritual and military leader.

faq.q: What is the strategic value of the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Stonetalon forms a rugged buffer between Ashenvale and Kalimdor's southern plains. Holding its outposts helps the night elves watch Horde movements from the Barrens and protect sacred lands.

faq.q: Do other Alliance races get recognized here?
aliases: can non night elves do this
faq.answer: Yes. Any Alliance adventurer who helps Sentinel Thenysil can travel to Darnassus, reflecting the growing defense shared by the night elves and the wider Alliance.

faq.q: Is there a follow-up quest after meeting Tyrande?
faq.answer: Meeting Tyrande concludes the Stonetalon courier and support work for Sentinel Thenysil. You can seek further orders in Darnassus.

angles.text: An audience with Tyrande Whisperwind links the night elves of Kalimdor with the wider Alliance, bringing recognition in Darnassus for service in the wilderness.
As a night elf, reporting to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon is a homecoming and a sign of your devotion to defending your ancestral lands.
